intro.name: The beginning
intro.text: Several coconuts disappear from the food stores. (Investigator) suspects theft.

text_only.reason: narrative: a few coconuts go missing and are found again; the stores are unchanged

a1.text: A child hid them for a treasure hunt and returns them apologetically.

a2.text: An innocent villager is accused, then publicly cleared.

a3.text: A witness remembers that the coconuts were moved for a feast.

b1.text: An animal carried several coconuts into the undergrowth.

b2.text: A forgotten storage basket is discovered behind a hut.

b3.text: The coconuts appear arranged in a mysterious spiral.

c1.text: The watchers catch friendly pranksters and demand they return them.

c2.text: The watchers fall asleep; the coconuts reappear anyway.

c3.text: The watch becomes a village game and everyone forgets the mystery.
